entities.summary: Political instability, Tsar Boris III's personal rule, alliance with Nazi Germany (1941), territorial gains in Thrace and Macedonia. Notably, Bulgaria saved its 48,000 Jews from deportation to death camps, though Jews from occupied territories were sent to their deaths.
